text: What if the internet went down for one whole day?
It already happened. In twenty twenty-two, twelve million Canadians lost their phones and internet. Debit cards stopped working across the country.
You wake up. No messages. No news. No maps.
You tap your card. Declined. Cash only.
Offices freeze. Email, video calls, cloud files: gone.
Airports go into chaos. In twenty twenty-four, one bad software update cancelled over five thousand flights in a single day.
No deliveries. No rides. No streaming.
And the bill for one day?
So, could you survive a day offline? Comment below.
